audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers put Malzahar's winning row in different places: the full layer had him at Level 6 (phases[4].side), while content win[] and the packet put him at Level 3 and gave Diana Level 6. The content whys[] array was shifted with them — whys[2] literally reads 'Malzahar flips level 6 hard' while sitting on the Level 3 row.
audit.why: Nether Grasp is a level 6 ability at 140s and 700 range; nothing in his kit changes at 3 while Diana gains Lunar Rush there. The full layer's placement is the one the kits support, so the Level 6 row is Malzahar's and Level 3 is Diana's.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Diana, Diana, Diana, Diana, Malzahar, Diana, Diana in both layers — win[2] moved to Diana to pair with phases[2].side, win[4] moved to Malzahar to pair with the existing phases[4].side, and whys[2], whys[3] and whys[4] rewritten to match their rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no numbers and treated level 6 as Diana's spike.
audit.why: The level 6 spike here is his: Nether Grasp 140/110/80. Diana's are Lunar Rush at 3 (22s) and first item.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten with the 140s number and the row attributed correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Void Shift was called a 'passive shield' (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text, wants.you[0]) and the two decisive interactions — the CC immunity and the Q silence — were never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity'. That is not a shield, and while it holds it ignores Moonfall's pull — so the Q has to land before any commit. Call of the Void is 900 range, 6s flat, and silences, which takes Lunar Rush and Moonfall away for its duration. Malefic Visions is a damage-over-time that spreads on a kill, so the health number matters, not the bar.
audit.corrected: Void Shift described correctly everywhere, the strip-then-commit sequence written into tradeGood, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.late, and the silence stated in dosFull[1].d and phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d called Nether Grasp a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1 and 80s at rank 3 — an order of magnitude off. Call of the Void 6 flat, Malefic Visions 11-7, Pale Cascade 15, Moonfall 100.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the wrong 15s claim replaced.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), phases[5].why's unsourced 'chunks half bars', and content late calling Nether Grasp a 'root cooldown'.
audit.why: The bleeds sit under unrelated titles, the magnitude has no source, and Nether Grasp suppresses rather than roots.
audit.corrected: All fixed in the edits below.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 54.2% win rate over 2,882 games and a chart Diana wins six rows of seven.
audit.why: The enums are exempt from the length band and were contradicting the win rate.
audit.corrected: diff, diffRating and tone moved to FAVOURED 5/10; carryRating left at 7.5/10 because the level 6 suppression is a genuine solo-kill threat.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Pale Cascade is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Nether Grasp is 140s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3: point-and-click suppression at 700 range, and the number that decides every step-up. - Call of the Void is 6s flat and silences. - Malefic Visions is 11s at rank 1. - Your Pale Cascade is 15s, Moonfall 100s.

notes: This is the only matchup in my slice where the two layers disagreed about WHICH row the enemy wins rather than just how it was labelled: the full layer put Malzahar at Level 6, content win[] and the packet put him at Level 3. I went with the full layer because Nether Grasp is a level 6 ability and nothing in his kit changes at 3, and proposed both win[] edits so the pairs are complete — win[2] to Diana alongside phases[2].side, win[4] to Malzahar alongside the existing phases[4].side. Final chart both layers: Diana, Diana, Diana, Diana, Malzahar, Diana, Diana. The content whys[] array was shifted with the old chart (whys[2] literally said 'flips level 6 hard' on the Level 3 row) and three entries were rewritten. The packet's suspectName 'Land Malefic Visions' in wants.foe[1] is a false positive — that is the correct ability name and the field was left alone. I did not write anything about QSS, Cleanse or tenacity against Nether Grasp's suppression; the kit file does not settle it.
